items.source: Note that there is a pre-built ThreadPoolTaskScheduler that allows for defining a ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor in bean style, exposing it as a Spring TaskScheduler directly. This is a convenient alternative to a raw ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor definition with a separate definition of the present adapter class.
items.translation: 请注意，有一个预构建的 ThreadPoolTaskScheduler，它允许以 Bean 风格定义一个 ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor，并直接将其暴露为 Spring TaskScheduler。这是使用原始 ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor 定义以及单独的适配器类定义的便捷替代方案。

items.source: Note: This will only apply to TaskScheduler invocations. If you want the given executor to apply to SchedulingTaskExecutor invocations as well, pass the same executor reference to ConcurrentTaskExecutor.setConcurrentExecutor(Executor).
items.translation: 注意：这仅适用于 `TaskScheduler` 调用。如果您希望给定的执行器也适用于 `SchedulingTaskExecutor` 调用，请将相同的执行器引用传递给 `ConcurrentTaskExecutor.setConcurrentExecutor(Executor)`。

items.source: Autodetects a JSR-236 ManagedScheduledExecutorService in order to use it for trigger-based scheduling if possible, instead of Spring's local trigger management which ends up delegating to regular delay-based scheduling against the java.util.concurrent.ScheduledExecutorService API. For JSR-236 style lookup in a Jakarta EE environment, consider using DefaultManagedTaskScheduler.
items.translation: 自动检测 JSR-236 `ManagedScheduledExecutorService`，以便在可能的情况下使用它进行基于触发器的调度，而不是使用 Spring 的本地触发器管理（最终会委托给针对 `java.util.concurrent.ScheduledExecutorService` API 的常规基于延迟的调度）。对于 Jakarta EE 环境中的 JSR-236 风格查找，请考虑使用 DefaultManagedTaskScheduler。
